newsitem.title: USA: Lucent ships wireless equipment chips.
newsitem.headline: Lucent ships wireless equipment chips.

text.p: Lucent Technologies Inc said on Thursday it started shipping its advanced digital signal-processor chips (DSP) to wireless equipment manufacturers.

The company said the DSP 1620 chips were the world's fastest. They operate at 120 million instructions per second (MIPS), about twice as fast as competing products. The specialized semiconductors perform high-speed mathematical computations with voice, data and video signals.
Lucent said the chip was designed for use in wireless infrastructure equipment, such as cellular base stations, where fewer DSPs could mean significant cost savings.
